login.title: Sign in to bosun
login.subtitle: Node panel
login.hint: The initial password is in bosun's first-start log; run bosun admin reset-password if it is lost.

mode.title: Mode
mode.fixedHint: panel.driver in config.yaml is fixed to {{driver}}; this panel is read-only. Set it to local to switch modes here.
mode.managedHint: Captain manages this node. Inbounds, users and forwards are edited in the panel; this UI is read-only.
mode.adoptHint: Get a pair code from “Add node” in Captain. The current inbounds, users and forwards are snapshotted first; the panel pushes its own state afterwards.
mode.adoptConfirm: Local config is disabled and saved as a snapshot; cores restart on the panel's state. Continue?
mode.detachConfirm: The panel loses control of this node; pairing again is needed to re-adopt. Continue?
mode.keepHint: The last state the panel pushed becomes the local config; otherwise the pre-takeover snapshot is restored.
mode.restoreHint: The snapshot taken before takeover will be restored.
mode.emptyHint: No snapshot: the node comes back empty.

inbounds.title: Inbounds
inbounds.subtitle: Protocol servers this machine offers. Saving applies immediately, no restart.
inbounds.emptyHint: No inbounds yet. Click “Add inbound” and pick a recipe.
inbounds.serverNameTls: Needs a certificate for this name under certs in config.yaml
inbounds.displayHint: When the entrance is elsewhere (an IPLC front door forwarding here), share links use this address and port.
inbounds.recipeHint: Pick a recipe to fill the fields and generate keys; edit anything afterwards.

recipes.vlessRealityDesc: Best TCP stealth; no certificate needed.
recipes.hysteria2Desc: QUIC, best throughput on lossy lines; needs a certificate.
recipes.mieruDesc: Low-signature TCP for IPLC and carrier QoS.
recipes.ss2022Desc: Lightweight; server key generated for you.
recipes.anytlsDesc: New protocol resisting traffic analysis; needs a certificate.

inbounds.serverNameAuto: Domain of the certificate; its DNS must point at this machine
inbounds.autoCertHint: Obtained and renewed from Let's Encrypt; no certificate files to manage
inbounds.acmeHttp: HTTP (port 80 here must be reachable from the internet)

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Who may use this node. Each user has a subscription link and traffic counters.
users.emptyHint: No users yet. Add one and send them the subscription link.
users.name: Name
users.quotaHint: 0 = unlimited; access stops when used up
users.onlineIps: Online IPs (visible on Xray and Hysteria cores)
users.subHint: Importing it gives the client every inbound this user may use.
users.rotateHint: The old link stops working immediately.

forwards.title: Forwards
forwards.subtitle: Relay TCP/UDP from a local port to the next hop, for relay chains.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Node identity, login and mode.
settings.publicHostHint: Server address in share links; blank uses the address this panel was opened on.
settings.coresHint: bosun only runs tested upstream releases, downloaded on first use.
settings.certsHint: Inbounds with “Automatic certificate” use this account. HTTP needs port 80 reachable; DNS goes through Cloudflare.
settings.cfTokenHint: DNS challenge only; permission Zone.DNS edit
settings.panelDomainHint: Serves the panel over HTTPS with an automatic certificate; restart after saving

logs.title: Logs
logs.subtitle: Recent bosun log lines; use journalctl -u bosun for everything.

update.title: Version and updates
update.devBuild: Development build: online updates are not offered.
update.containerHint: A binary swapped inside the container is lost on the next recreate. Pull the new image on the host instead:
update.applyConfirm: Download {{version}}, verify it, replace the running binary and restart. Cores restart too, so users drop for a few seconds. Continue?
update.rollbackConfirm: Switch back to {{version}} and restart. Continue?
update.restartConfirm: The process exits and systemd or Docker starts it again; cores restart. Continue?
update.restarting: Restarting, waiting for the service to come back…
